text_block_list.text:
Early morning. Silence Suzuka was doing 
her training alone today as well, but—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa... —Phew.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Is she not coming today?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Taiki. For this morning's training— 
...Wait, what's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...Oh. Suzuka... Good morning~...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Last night, a package from Papa and Mama 
arrived, yes... And there was a letter 
inside...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...WAAAAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
(Homesick, maybe? Taiki... must have been 
enduring it for a while)

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Right. You do get lonely easily—

Mmm-hmm! Lord Shiraoki says there's 
someone in distress around here... Ah!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
...I see, I see! In other words, you want 
to save Taiki-san!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I-I wouldn't go so far as saying 'save', 
but...! Um, I am worried about her...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It's okay, I totally understand! Let's ask 
Lord Shiraoki right away about 
homesickness!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hunyaka~... hanyaka~... Hmm~? 'Enfold them 
with love'...? Mmm... does anything come 
to mind?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Nnnghh, Suzuka~~!! Please let me hug 
yooouuuu♪"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well... If it's something that comes 
to mind, maybe...?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Then let us do it!! Special hug training!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I explained the situation, and Pearl-san 
agreed to help us out!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka... First, show me a hug with 
everything you've got!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: You've got to be kidding...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: F-For now... I'll give it a try, okay...?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...H-Hop.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Too soft!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That is no hug! It's practically a 
handshake! ...Fukukitaru, show her how 
it's done!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Understood, going all out!! 
Teryaaaaaaaaaaaaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: NOOOOOOOOOO?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
*Gah*... That is the kind of fighting 
spirit you need...! Suzuka, let's try one 
more time!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: H-Hyaah!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Still too sooofftt!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, you're having trouble cutting loose, 
aren't you? Even though you accelerate 
with such unbelievable force during races—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Aha! Then why not just run into it?! Carry 
that momentum into a jumping hug, that's 
it!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
A plan that utilizes Suzuka's speed, 
marvelous! Though it's dangerous, so let's 
stop right before the hug.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No, if she stops, the momentum will... 
Wait?! I see, the wind! The gale she 
carries from running will blow furiously 
around them, right?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
The wind enveloping the two! An embrace 
within the storm! Oh... It's so 
romantic...!!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Suzuka, how about it?!?! Suzuka-san, what 
do you think?!?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I just have to do my best and put power 
into it! That's all it takes, right...?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Setting the whole running part aside...!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Haa... H-Here I go...!!

One day, I spotted Taiki Shuttle walking 
dejectedly. Just as I was about to ask 
what was wrong—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Taiki-i-i-i-i!

Turning around at the sudden shout, I saw 
Silence Suzuka marching over with 
tremendous intensity!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Suzuka?! W-What in the—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Taiki!! ...Squee-e-e-e-ze!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: GUEEEEEEEEEEKKK!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ............Um, Taiki. Well—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Let's make a proper promise for once. 
Tomorrow morning... let's run together. 
...Okay?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: ...Su...... Suzuka—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Mmm! Big love, yeeeess! HUUUUUUUUUUUG!!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: KYAAAAAAAAAAAAH?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Ow-w-w-w... As expected of the original, 
truly formidable...
